rotation.objective: mean squared geodesic radians on float64 SVD-projected SO(3) inputs
rotation.interpolation: Exp(alpha*Log(Rfast*Rslow.T))*Rslow; principal log, largest-axis positive at exact pi
rotation.certificate_scope: numerical guarded bound for projected interpolation only; not float32 production or formal interval arithmetic
rotation.projection_method: float64 SVD U diag(1,1,det(UVt)) Vt; no input mutation
rotation.tie_rule: smallest evaluated alpha among exact equal float64 objectives
rotation.queue_rule: smallest interval lower bound, then left endpoint, then interval id
